description: Read Woodpecker CI repositories, pipelines and logs, and drive builds, secrets and crons
name: io.github.ni-c/woodpecker-ci-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Root URL of the Woodpecker server, e.g. https://woodpecker.example.com
environmentVariables.name: WOODPECKER_URL

environmentVariables.description: Personal access token from the Woodpecker user settings
environmentVariables.name: WOODPECKER_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to register only the read tools (default: false)
environmentVariables.name: WOODPECKER_READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to register; 'essential' selects a curated preset (default: all tools)
environmentVariables.name: WOODPECKER_ALLOW_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to remove from whatever the allow list left
environmentVariables.name: WOODPECKER_DENY_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to accept a self-signed certificate from the Woodpecker server (default: false)
environmentVariables.name: WOODPECKER_INSECURE_TLS

title: Woodpecker CI
